_comment: Category buckets used by the triage classifier prompt. Edit this file to change which symptoms count toward each category; the prompt builder reads from here so no code change is needed. Status is DRAFT_PENDING_CLINICIAN until a clinician approves (PRD sections 6 and 9). 'catalogue' entries reference ids/codes in symptoms.json. 'text_only' entries describe red flags that have no matching catalogue symptom and must be detected from the patient's free text.

Emergency.description: Any one of these, present and not negated, makes the category Emergency. Stop and hand off to a person (handoff implemented in a later phase).

catalogue.note: unconscious, not waking up, or no response
fever with headache and stiff neck (combine with fever + headache)

Severe.description: Any one of these makes the category Severe (unless an Emergency rule already fired). Several are combination rules evaluated with AGE, SEX, PREGNANT and DURATION_DAYS.

catalogue.note: fever; escalates with age <5, age >=65, vomiting, diarrhoea or dehydration
fever; escalates with age <5, age >=65, vomiting, diarrhoea or dehydration

text_only: pregnant and any new symptom other than mild cold symptoms
duration 3 days or more and more than one symptom
pain severe enough to stop daily activity
symptoms from three or more different body areas

Normal.description: No Emergency or Severe rule applies. Everything not escalated falls here.
